testCases.title: Verify text to speech conversion workflow
testCases.description: Verify that text entered into the application can be successfully converted into speech audio as required by REQ-1788332865292-01.
testCases.expectedResult: Application converts text into clear and understandable audio speech successfully within a few seconds.

testData.inputText: Hello, this is a test for text to speech conversion.

sourceEvidence.reason: Requirement REQ-1788332865292-01 acceptance criteria requires converting entered text into clear audio successfully within a few seconds.

testCases.title: Verify error message display when text input is empty
testCases.description: Verify that attempting to start speech generation with an empty text input displays an appropriate error message.
testCases.expectedResult: Appropriate error message is displayed when text input is empty and audio generation is not started.

sourceEvidence.reason: Requirement REQ-1788332865292-01 acceptance criteria mandates that an appropriate error message is displayed when text input is empty.
